models.notes: AuK-Flash, quick: one edit of a take of up to 30 s, in the same voice, with no transcript needed: words replaced, inserted or removed; faster or slower, higher or lower, louder or quieter on AuK's trained steps; a new emotion, timbre or accent; to or from a whisper; denoised or dereverberated; a breath, laugh, cough or hum added at the start or end, or removed. Content and speed edits change the length: give target_duration_s to fit a cue. Mandarin edits need the int8 or bf16 lane. Research use only (Qwen Research licence).
